timing_scope: end-to-end encode, end-to-end decode to standard binary PLY; excludes renderer, outer process startup and adapter module import; lazy imports inside codec functions are included
cache_policy: OS page cache not flushed; methods run serially

encode_details.algorithm: stable GOP Morton; exact SH dictionary; static/immutable once; AV1 dynamic delta byte planes
encode_details.keyframe_codec: stored NPZ + single-thread LZMA2, preset6, 32MiB dictionary
